    45	/-- A witness at one prime is contained in a basic open on which the datum-pair H1
    46	fibre vanishes at every prime. -/
    47	theorem exists_basicOpen_h1_vanishing
    48	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    49	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
    50	    (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    51	    ∃ h : B, h ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, h ∉ q.asIdeal →
    52	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    53	  have hp' : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
    54	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mp hp
    55	  obtain ⟨U, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hpU, hU⟩ :=
    56	    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hp'
    57	      (datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing D hpi)
    58	  refine ⟨h, (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen h p).mp hpU, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    59	  exact hU ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen h q).mpr hq)
    60	
    61	/-- Fibrewise H1 vanishing on a basic open is the rigid-engine hypothesis for the
    62	datum pulled to its away localization. -/
    63	theorem hfib_baseChange_away
    64	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (h : B)
    65	    (hvan : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, h ∉ q.asIdeal →
    66	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    67	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away h)) :
    68	    Subsingleton ((datumPair (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h))).H1
    69	      ⊗[Localization.Away h] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    70	  let p : PrimeSpectrum B :=
    71	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) q
    72	  have hhp : h ∉ p.asIdeal := by
    73	    intro hh
    74	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
    75	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hh) ?_)
    76	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit h
    77	  have hp : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
    78	    hvan p hhp
    79	  have hpw : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    80	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mpr hp
    81	  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap B p.asIdeal.ResidueField h) :=
    82	    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 =>
    83	      hhp (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp h0)
    84	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    85	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away h) h hunit).toAlgebra
    86	  haveI : IsScalarTower B (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    87	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    88	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
    89	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

    91	  have hcom : p.asIdeal = q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) := rfl

    93	    Ideal.ResidueField.map p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
    94	      (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) hcom
    95	  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField := psi.toAlgebra
    96	  haveI : IsScalarTower B p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    97	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    98	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    99	      ext b
   100	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap,
   101	        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (Localization.Away h)])
   102	  have hDq : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   103	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
   104	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField).mp hpw
   105	  have hcl :
   106	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass =
   107	        Scheme.CechPic.map
   108	          (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away h) q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   109	          (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)).cechPicClass := by

   111	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   112	      relCurveMap_comp]
   113	  have hDq' : (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)).HasWitnessH1Vanishing
   114	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   115	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq
   116	      (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)) q.asIdeal.ResidueField hcl).mp hDq

   120	/-- If a module has a nontrivial fibre at `p`, its base change to any away
   121	neighbourhood of `p` is nontrivial. -/
   122	theorem nontrivial_away_tensor_of_nontrivial_fibre
   123	    {Q : Type u} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module B Q]
   124	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (h : B) (hh : h ∉ p.asIdeal)
   125	    (hp : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] Q)) :
   126	    Nontrivial (Localization.Away h ⊗[B] Q) := by
   127	  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap B p.asIdeal.ResidueField h) :=
   128	    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 =>
   129	      hh (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp h0)
   130	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   131	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away h) h hunit).toAlgebra
   132	  haveI : IsScalarTower B (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   133	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   134	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
   135	  by_contra hnt
   136	  rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hnt
   137	  have hleft : Subsingleton (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.Away h]
   138	      (Localization.Away h ⊗[B] Q)) := inferInstance
   139	  have hright : Subsingleton (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] Q) :=
   140	    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange B (Localization.Away h)
   141	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField Q).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp hleft
   142	  exact (not_subsingleton (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] Q)) hright

   145	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
   146	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L

   150	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=

   168	/-- A pulled datum class has unchanged degree at a prime lying over the base prime. -/
   169	theorem classDeg_map_residueField_of_comap
   170	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   171	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Algebra B S]
   172	    [IsScalarTower k B S] (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (q : PrimeSpectrum S)
   173	    (hq : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B S) q = p) (n : ℕ)
   174	    (hdegp : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   175	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   176	        D.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ)) :
   177	    classDeg q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   178	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   179	        D.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ) := by
   180	  have hcom : p.asIdeal = q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B S) := by
   181	    simpa using congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq.symm
   182	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[k] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   183	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   184	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B S) hcom
   185	  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   186	    rho.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   187	  haveI : IsScalarTower k p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   188	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (rho.commutes x).symm
   189	  haveI : IsScalarTower B p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   190	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   191	      change algebraMap B q.asIdeal.ResidueField x =
   192	        rho (algebraMap B p.asIdeal.ResidueField x)
   193	      rw [Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ_apply, Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap]
   194	      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B S q.asIdeal.ResidueField x
   195	  have hcurve : (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap rho).left =
   196	      relCurveMap C p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
   197	    refine congrArg
   198	      (fun t : overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⟶
   199	        overSpec k p.asIdeal.ResidueField => (C ◁ t).left) ?_
   200	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   201	  have hinv := classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition C rho
   202	    (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   203	      D.cechPicClass)
   204	  rw [hcurve] at hinv
   205	  have hpic : Scheme.CechPic.map
   206	      (relCurveMap C p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   207	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   208	        D.cechPicClass) =
   209	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   210	        D.cechPicClass := by
   211	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
   212	  exact (congrArg (classDeg q.asIdeal.ResidueField) hpic.symm).trans
   213	    (hinv.trans hdegp)

   218	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k B L] (n g : ℕ)
